selection: S4A caption specifies CSOB, 120 seconds, two hours after the 2024 Md4.4 Solfatara earthquake. Interpret two hours literally from the official bulletin's 18:10:03 UTC time. Exact author window start is not specified in caption text.
context_role: Identifies the earthquake named by the written benchmark specification only. Not an input to independent detection, association, location or event filtering.
status: Partial S4A counterpart; different exact window may have been used. No independent reference labels or accuracy estimate. Not a retraining demonstration.
preprocessing: Demean, causal four-pole 1 Hz highpass; released normalization/default overlap/blinding; threshold 0.3. Raw Z spectrogram: 256 samples, 192 overlap.
